more_info.overview: Candelilla wax is used as a thickener in food. Its technological role is to increase the thickness of food.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include entire fresh fruit and vegetables, cocoa and chocolate products as covered by directive 2000/36/ec, other confectionery including breath freshening micro-sweets, chewing gum. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Purified wax obtained from the leaves of the candelilla plant. It is plant derived.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The specified starting material is plant derived and compatible with vegetarian and vegan diets. The specification does not establish halal or kosher certification.
